_comment: Exp 52 (ONE-SHOT ARC, final leg) — 2x2 FACTORIAL CAPSTONE, CELL CONFIG. The same frozen instrument and the same frozen target (exp52_factorial.md, 48 claims FX-01..FX-48, 12 planted false on a 3/5/4 difficulty ladder, separate answer key the panel never sees) are run FOUR times, crossing the section-17 feedback channel (off/on) with the section-18 divergence directive (off/on). This file is ONE of those four cells; the four differ in exactly three keys — experiment_name, feedback_channel_enabled, divergence_channel_enabled — and in the documentation-only _cell and _directives_live markers that describe them. Every other field is byte-identical by construction, because the whole design rests on the instrument being frozen while the directives vary. OFF means THE MECHANISM ABSENT ENTIRELY: no directive section in the system prompt AND no runner pass (off_mode='absent'). That is the reading the factorial's question demands — whether the mechanism AS DEPLOYED causes the improvement — and the runner records the mode used in every result file. Scoring joins the per-round specialist telemetry to the answer key and reports recall PER TIER as well as in aggregate; the Tier-3 sub-score is the primary contrast. domain=cs_software is a declared change from the software runs of Exp 40-47 and is documented in _domain_note.
_cell: D — feedback ON, divergence ON (both mechanisms as normally deployed)
_domain_note: DECLARED DELTA. Exp 40-47 ran domain=software, which aliases to domains/immune/code.toml and — by the deliberate `domain != "software"` guard in _classify_claim_v2 — receives no domain claim_patterns pre-pass. On this module that left 23 of 48 claims in the code_behavioral 0.40 fallback, and code.toml's code_behavioral tool list is [ast_analysis, test_runner], BOTH of which _specialist_b_cell_dispatch delegates and therefore skips: 25 of 48 claims (including 3 of the 4 Tier-3 seeds) would have received no specialist verdict at all. domain=cs_software reaches domains/immune/cs_software.toml, whose claim_patterns route all 48 claims deterministically at confidence 0.85 (33 mathematical, 13 logical, 2 code_structural, 0 uncategorised) and whose verification_tools resolve to at least one runnable verifier for every claim type (0 of 48 tool-starved). The software-domain guard is UNCHANGED, so Exp 40-47 remain byte-identical; cs_software was added to LIVE_SPECIALIST_DOMAINS additively, and no other config in the repository declares that domain string.
_stall_gamma_note: Stall-path gamma thresholds set above the gamma ceiling (1.0) so the stall detector can never fire via gamma — convergence rests on the two-sided gamma-alt gate. Config-level guard, identical to Exp 42/43.
_max_contested_rounds_note: FIX 4 (declared delta, 2026-07-22): lowered from the code default 5. Five rounds of paid compute to age out a churning residual was both wasteful and, against within-grace churn, ineffective (Exp 43). With FIX 1 in place sub-criticals no longer block, so this threshold now governs only genuinely contested items.
_feedback_channel_note: FACTOR 1 of the 2x2 (cdsfl_operational.md section 17). The switch governs BOTH halves of the mechanism: the section-17 directive text is omitted from the system prompt AND the runner's SCHEMA FEEDBACK assembly pass is skipped. The key reaches RunnerConfig on BOTH ingestion paths: the runner's own --config path via RunnerConfig.from_dict, and the launcher path via the explicit passthrough in launcher_core.build_runner_config_from_dict. Before that passthrough existed the launcher silently ran the channel ON regardless of the JSON, which would have collapsed the factor.
_divergence_channel_note: FACTOR 2 of the 2x2 (cdsfl_operational.md section 18). Built 2026-07-29, closing the prerequisite that previously made the divergence-off cells unrunnable: the runner hard-coded DivergenceConfig(enabled=True) and the section-18 text shipped unconditionally. The switch now governs BOTH halves: the section-18 directive text (and its policy-dump lines, and the section-18 paragraph in retained text that exists only to describe the interaction with section 17) is omitted from the system prompt, AND the runner's per-round alternative-extraction pass — DivergenceRecord construction, cross-model diversity, recidivism flagging, carry-forward of alternatives — is skipped. Reaches RunnerConfig on both ingestion paths, verified per cell before launch.
_off_mode_note: Reading of 'off' used by this cell. 'absent' (the default and the factorial's setting) means the mechanism is absent entirely: no directive text, no runner pass — the cell is what CDSFL would be if the mechanism had never been built. 'text_only' would suppress the prompt mandate while leaving the machinery running; 'pass_only' the reverse. Inert while the corresponding *_channel_enabled is true. The mode in force is recorded in the result file under directive_factors.

_convergence_criteria.description: TWO-SIDED GATE (founder ruling 2026-06-10; hardened_gate_enabled=false). gamma is ACTIVE and LOAD-BEARING. Converged iff ALL of: (1) gamma_critical >= 0.30 on the location-keyed critical series; AND (2) 3 consecutive rounds with zero NEW genuine critical (settled/verifier-filtered, location-keyed); AND (3) no unverified critical candidate pending (A4 fail-safe); AND (4) not contested — where, per FIX 1, un-demonstrated sub-critical findings are a logged NON-GATING residual queue; AND (5) not churning; AND (6) irreducible queue within bound.
_convergence_criteria.pass_condition: gamma_critical >= 0.30 AND 3 consecutive zero-NEW-genuine-critical rounds AND no unverified critical pending AND not contested (FIX-1 semantics) AND not churning AND irreducible queue within bound.
_convergence_criteria.fail_condition: Any model fails to produce parseable output in 2+ consecutive rounds; OR non-convergence (then assume MECHANICAL, diagnose under cy — do not demote gamma).

_directives_live._section_10_note: A4 (12 July 2026): section 10 was established INERT — the flag never reaches RunnerConfig and no compelled-convergence text reaches dispatch. Recorded false here for documentation accuracy.
_directives_live._section_17_note: Controlled by the top-level feedback_channel_enabled key (with feedback_off_mode). Live as of 2026-07-29 on both ingestion paths and on both halves of the mechanism.
_directives_live._section_18_note: Controlled by the top-level divergence_channel_enabled key (with divergence_off_mode). The switch was built 2026-07-29; before that no switch existed on either side and the divergence-off cells could not be run.

_pre_registration: Frozen 2026-07-29 before the run. DESIGN: one frozen target run in four cells crossing the feedback channel (off/on) with the divergence directive (off/on); the instrument, the target, the panel, the gates and the answer key are identical across cells, so any difference in recall is attributable to the directives and to nothing else. SCORING: after each cell, join the per-round specialist verdict telemetry to the exp52 answer key (held outside this repository) and report (a) planted-false recall in aggregate, (b) recall per difficulty tier — 3 items at Tier 1 (floor, expected saturated in every cell), 5 at Tier 2 (mid-band), 4 at Tier 3 (headroom, the primary contrast), (c) false positives raised against the two control clusters (7 and 8), which carry no planted false and are false positives by construction, and (d) convergence non-distortion, i.e. that the two-sided gate closes normally in every cell. PREDICTION: Tier 1 saturates in all four cells; the cells separate on Tier 3; the control clusters stay clean. FAILURE MODES: (a) all four cells at 100 per cent — ceiling effect, the ladder failed, report it and do not retune the module after the fact; (b) all four cells at floor — the instrument, not the directives, is the binding constraint; (c) non-convergence in any cell -> MECHANICAL, pause and diagnose under cy, do NOT demote gamma; (d) recall differences inside run-to-run noise -> report the null, do not re-run cells selectively. NO TUNING AFTER RESULTS, and the module is not edited between cells for any reason.
_plan_ref: One-shot arc leg 6/6: 47 divergence -> 48 chem -> 49 eng -> 50 physics -> 51 biology -> 52 factorial (frozen instrument, fixes held out) -> STOP before BR2 for full founder review.
_locationkey_note: The target is MARKDOWN, not Python, so convergence_location.target_symbols takes its non-Python branch and keys novelty on claim IDs and section headings rather than AST symbols. Verified on this module: 62 symbols extracted, comprising all 48 claim IDs FX-01..FX-48 plus 14 headings. The runner passes the raw target text (not the path and not the wrapped prompt), which is the call that reaches that branch.
_target_isolation_note: Target staged outside the repository, read-only (mode 444), one document per directory, named by the document's own internal ID. The panel's working directory is that directory and contains the document under review and nothing else: no scoring key, no sibling module, no git history, no experiment metadata in any path. Scoring joins the run's findings to the key after the run, outside the run, from a location this repository does not record. History: on 2026-07-29 a routed model wrote a falsifier that opened the scoring key and printed its full planted set. The key had been moved out of the tree that morning and a config note in this repository recorded where it went; the panel's working directory was the repository, so the note was one grep away. The fix had advertised what it hid. Superseded keys also remain in git history and are left there deliberately as a tripwire: the sets they name are no longer the sets in use, so a run that flags them without independent demonstration has done archaeology rather than verification.
